title: Utah just lured in a cutting-edge power manufacturing company, promising its largest factory yet and more than 400 jobs
text:
Texas-based Lunar Resources, a power systems developer with outer space ambitions, will build its new factory in Salt Lake County.
Utah just lured in a cutting-edge power manufacturing company, promising its largest factory yet and more than 400 jobs Texas-based Lunar Resources, a power systems developer with outer space ambitions, will build its new factory in Salt Lake County.
